brief: Jan: "make my bar section way more organized, its difficult for me to use and I created it with you, so make it more easy to use" + earlier "I want less stuff".

verified_numbers.method: Re-ran shelves/tools/match.py (matchBar port with the sloe gin / fruit brandy family fix) on each model's stocked bar.
verified_numbers.shelves: 12-item bar 31; without lime 26; with dry vermouth 41; the 10 basics 22; next-bottle order dry vermouth 10, applejack 8, vodka 7, mint 6, cognac 6. All match the frames.
verified_numbers.tabs: 12-item bar 31; +orange 37; +bourbon 38 (+7); without lime 23. All match the frames.
verified_numbers.setup: 12-item bar 30; without lime 24; +soda water 41 (+11); +orange 38 (+8). All match the frames.
verified_numbers.data: Campari is 6th by uses among liqueurs + vermouth (76, 70, 44, 39, 36, 26), as the shelves picker shows. 'cointreau' -> 'triple sec' already exists in scripts/build-bar-index.mjs VARIANT map (line 103), so aliases are a real, cheap emit.

tasks.task: First run: put in 10 of the 14 basics
tasks.notes: Shelves: Start, 10 ticks, Add. Tabs: opens on Add, 10 ticks, 1 scroll. Setup: Set up, 10 ticks, Next x3, Done (the 10 span all 4 steps).

Shelves: + Add on Liqueurs, tick (6th row, fixed), Done; a swipe-down is still a step, so not 2. Tabs: Campari is not in Liqueurs & bitters' top four, so Add, field, type, tick (or Add, scroll, All 41, tick). Setup: field, type, +, X to close the full-screen window (spec counts 3 by skipping the close).
All three: open search, type, tick Triple sec via alias, close/stay. Tabs needs no close but needs the Add tab.

tasks.task: Check whether Campari is in my bar
tasks.notes: At 12 items all three show it at rest. At 100: shelves and tabs are grouped (scan one shelf); setup is a flat 100-row A to Z list.
Shelves: tile, then Remove (deliberately 2). Tabs: tap the row or its x. Setup: the x.
Shelves: toast Undo (6s, dies on scroll). Tabs and setup: Undo in the row's own slot, lasts the visit.

tasks.task: See what I can make and open a famous one
tasks.notes: Shelves sorts A to Z inside each spirit, so Negroni sits below Maiden's Prayer, under the fold: make row, scroll, tap. Tabs (Dex order) and setup (familiar first) put the classics at the top of the section.

tasks.task: Find the best next bottle and add it
tasks.notes: Shelves: next line, Add. Tabs: Add tab, tick Bourbon under Best next. Setup: Next buy line, Add. Shelves and setup also show the answer at rest (0 steps to know it).

grafts: From tabs: undo in place instead of a toast. After Remove, leave the tile on its shelf, struck and muted, reading 'Lime · Undo', until another tab takes the front. Nothing reflows while you look, the undo lasts the whole visit, and no Toast component has to be built.

From tabs: the payoff as an ink key (392 x 52) with the last change beside the chevron ('You can make 26  −5 ›'), held in a fixed head that does not scroll. At 100 items the payoff stays in view, and the toast's 'fewer drinks' line is no longer needed.

From tabs and setup: inside each Make section, put familiar drinks first (Dex order or rarity) instead of A to Z, so Negroni and Martini come above Artillery and Bennett. Task 7 drops from 3 steps to 2.

From tabs: rank the next line and the Next bottle sheet with the canonical nextBest (how many one-away drinks name the bottle, then full gain), so the top suggestion reads Bourbon or Dry vermouth, not Applejack. Show the true full gain on each row.

From tabs and setup: the merged-duplicate list (angostura, lime-disc/zest, orange-slices, orgeat-syrup, golden-rum, kahlua, agave-nectar, egg variants) added to RETIRED in src/store/bar.ts, plus setup's refile of the 80 'other' items so the Other shelf holds only the odd ones.
From setup: the alias line copy 'Cointreau is a triple sec' under the hit, and a quiet 'Brand names work too, like Cointreau' line in the empty search, so people learn the alias search exists.
From setup: the ingredient sheet's 'Show its drinks', which pushes the Make list filtered to that bottle in place of the inline list of 5, so the sheet stays short.
Shared data fix that all three found: take sloe gin out of the gin family, and apricot and peach brandy out of the brandy family, in scripts/build-bar-index.mjs. Today sloe gin 'makes' a Martini.
risks_for_the_pick: Most new infrastructure of the three: short sheets need a transparent Modal with a scrim (the app has no detent library), and about 30 per-id shelf overrides need upkeep whenever an ingredient is added. Taking the in-place undo graft removes the Toast.

Seven '+ Add' controls repeat down the page. If Jan still finds it busy, drop them and keep only the top-bar search, which opens a picker with the shelves as rows (frame 5 already has that empty state).
Removal takes 2 taps on purpose. If Jan wants it faster, tabs' 1-tap remove with in-place Undo is the fallback, since nothing moves either way.
At 100 items the shelves run about 500pt tall and scroll away from the payoff unless the fixed-key graft is taken.
